content.text: What This Actually Is and Why It Matters

NOWPayments supports over 300 cryptocurrencies across multiple blockchain networks. For practical digital product sales, the most operationally useful options are USDT on Tron — fastest settlement under 60 seconds, fees under $0.10, widely held in restricted markets — USDT on Ethereum — higher fees but the most widely supported chain globally — Bitcoin — highest global recognition, 10 to 60 minute confirmation depending on network congestion — Solana — fast settlement, fees of fractions of a cent, growing adoption — and BNB on Binance Smart Chain — popular in Southeast Asia and widely available through Binance.
How the Architecture Works Under the Hood

The architecture behind Cloudflare Workers crypto payment webhooks involves leveraging Cloudflare's edge network to process payments and trigger webhooks. This process starts when a customer makes a USDT payment on the NOWPayments platform, which is integrated with Cloudflare Workers. Once the payment is confirmed, the webhook is triggered, and the Cloudflare Workers script executes, sending a notification to the creator's email. The script can also be configured to store the payment details in Supabase or Google Sheets for record-keeping purposes.
Who This Is Built For and Why

This infrastructure solution is built for digital creators in restricted markets who struggle with delayed payouts and limited access to payment platforms. It is particularly relevant for creators in Africa, Latin America, and Asia, where the use of cryptocurrencies and peer-to-peer exchanges is increasingly popular. The solution is designed to be cost-effective, with transaction fees of under $0.10 per USDT transaction on the Tron network.
USDT transactions on the Tron network cost under $0.10 per transaction.
The Components That Make It Work Together

The fee structure of NOWPayments is fundamentally different from conventional platform fees. NOWPayments charges 0.5% per transaction. There is no monthly fee, no setup fee, no payout fee, and no minimum transaction volume requirement. Network fees for the underlying blockchain transaction are paid by the buyer and vary by network — Tron fees are under $0.10, Solana fees are fractions of a cent, Bitcoin fees average $1 to $5 for most transactions. For a $97 product sold through the Sovereign Starter Stack, the total transaction cost is approximately $0.49 to NOWPayments plus network fees typically under $0.10 on Tron. Compare this to Gumroad's 10% fee on the same transaction — $9.70.
How to Use This Knowledge to Deploy Today

To deploy this infrastructure solution today, creators can follow these steps: purchase the Edge Commerce Stack ($197) from COREMERCH, which includes Stack 02 deployed in 48 hours, Cloudflare Pages + Workers + Supabase + NOWPayments, 5 products loaded, SPF/DKIM/DMARC configured, and end-to-end tested before handoff; configure the NOWPayments platform to receive USDT payments; set up a Supabase or Google Sheets database to store payment details; and write a Cloudflare Workers script to process payments and trigger webhooks.
How do I receive crypto payments for my digital products?

Getting paid in crypto is operationally simpler than it appears. You configure your wallet address in NOWPayments once — this takes under 30 minutes. From that point, every sale deposits automatically into your wallet without any action required from you. The transaction hash in your order log is cryptographic proof of every payment. When you want to convert to local currency, you transfer USDT from your wallet to your exchange account and post a P2P sell order. The buyer sends local currency to your bank account or mobile money account and you release the USDT. Most P2P transactions complete in under 30 minutes.
Cloudflare Workers can be used to process payments and trigger webhooks for multiple cryptocurrencies.
Related: How Creators Like You Are Building Sovereign Stores

For digital creators who want to take their infrastructure to the next level, COREMERCH offers a range of solutions, including the Edge Commerce Stack ($197), which provides a comprehensive digital commerce stack with automatic crypto payment processing, instant product delivery, and full data ownership. Additionally, creators can shop for digital products and services at https://coremerch.github.io/products.html.
Your Deployment Checklist

Configure your payout destination before configuring your store. Your self-custody wallet address goes into NOWPayments as the destination for each coin you accept — this is where funds land when a transaction confirms on-chain. Never use an exchange wallet address as your NOWPayments destination — use a self-custody wallet where you control the private keys. Set up Binance P2P or a local exchange and verify the conversion process for your local currency pair. Deploy your stack and run a mainnet test. After the first real sale confirms, wait for the transaction to fully clear in NOWPayments, then transfer from your self-custody wallet to your exchange for conversion.
Frequently Asked Questions
What is the role of NOWPayments in the infrastructure solution?

NOWPayments is a cryptocurrency payment platform that enables USDT payments and other cryptocurrencies to be processed directly on the creator's website. It provides a secure and cost-effective way for creators to receive payments from their customers.
Can I use a different cryptocurrency other than USDT?

Yes, you can use other cryptocurrencies supported by NOWPayments, such as Bitcoin, Ethereum, or Litecoin. However, the transaction fees and payment processing times may vary depending on the cryptocurrency used.
How do I configure the Supabase or Google Sheets database to store payment details?

To configure the Supabase or Google Sheets database, you will need to create a new database table to store payment details, such as payment ID, customer name, and payment amount. You can then integrate the database with the Cloudflare Workers script to store payment details automatically.
Can I use a different email service provider other than Cloudflare Email?

Yes, you can use a different email service provider, such as Gmail or Outlook, to receive notifications from the Cloudflare Workers script. However, you will need to configure the email settings and SPF, DKIM, and DMARC settings to ensure email deliverability.
